name: Marko Vešligaj - § 21/2
title: REPORT on the Gender Equality Strategy 2025
part_text: and calls on the Commission to increase investment in gender mainstreaming in health systems
part_context: Calls on EU Member States to ensure and guarantee access to essential healthcare services and medications and calls on the Commission to increase investment in gender mainstreaming in health systems; stresses that the training of all medical professionals and healthcare workers should include a gendered approach; calls on the Commission to ensure that no one, especially women with disabilities, is subjected to harmful, invasive or irreversible treatments against their will, and to establish that all medical interventions are based on each individual’s personal, free and fully informed consent;
